breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification produces P_max = 1000 N = 2W, which is exactly the incorrect suddenly-applied-load result the incomplete prompt imposed. The ground truth requires solving the energy conservation equation W(h + δ_max) = P_max²L/(2AE) with the nonzero drop height h = 200 mm, which yields P_max ≈ 154,000 N — orders of magnitude larger. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.
